content: Hi there! How can I assist with your taxes?
I own a small business. What are some common deductions I might be missing?

Great question! Some often-overlooked deductions include software subscriptions, business mileage, phone and internet expenses (if used for business), and even a portion of your home utilities if you work from home. Do you also have employees or contractors?
Just a couple of contractors. Can I deduct what I pay them?
Absolutely! Payments to contractors are fully deductible as business expenses, and you should also issue 1099-NEC forms if you paid them $600 or more during the year.
